retained_rows.assessment_basis: The agency’s self-initiated audit found anomalous authorised-user queries and the continuing inquiry identified a fourth allegation with an October 2023–December 2025 search period. That positively demonstrates context-appropriate traceability of operational ALPR processes/decisions sufficient to answer these inquiries in 2026. It is bounded to audit detection, without proving every query was logged correctly, preventive purpose controls existed or any person’s criminal guilt.
